scope: ALEX only. Educator rules, MOGO implementation behaviour and replay observations are kept in separate fields and are never merged.
lineageWarning: This matrix compares MOGO's implementation against the EDUCATOR library. That comparison has never been performed before and is OBSERVATIONAL ONLY. alex_g_sr_v1's rules are MOGO's own (DECISION|MOGO|20260727|004); any agreement below is CONVERGENCE, NOT DERIVATION. This matrix does not re-specify the production strategy and does not merge the two bodies of knowledge (KEREV-B remains open).

attributionAvailability.note: Unit B (v12.11.0) added ruleIds/triggeredConditions to newly captured packages. RUN-001 was captured on engine 12.9.0 and carries none, so condition-level joins are unavailable for this run and every conditionIds list below is empty. Field-level joins are unaffected.

statusVocabulary.LINKED: MOGO implements this rule and at least one RUN-001 package carries the declared evidence field.
statusVocabulary.NOT_EXERCISED: MOGO implements this rule but no RUN-001 package carries the declared field populated.
statusVocabulary.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The fidelity matrix records that MOGO does not implement this educator rule.
statusVocabulary.UNSUPPORTED: MOGO implements behaviour the educator library does not support (MOGO-authored).
statusVocabulary.UNRESOLVED: No fidelity row, no declared evidence mapping, or a fidelity status that asserts no implementation.

MET_PROFIT_FACTOR.name: Profit factor
MET_PROFIT_FACTOR.formula: gross positive R / abs(gross negative R)

minimumSampleBasis: Declared in advance, not derived from these results. Below roughly 30 resolved trades per arm, a 2R/-1R system's win-rate estimate is dominated by variance and no difference between arms is distinguishable from noise.

educator.statement: Support is where price has previously held; resistance is where price has previously been rejected. Support/resistance, supply/demand and 'area of interest' are the same concept under three names.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Role derived positionally: above->support, below->resistance, within->inside.

educator.statement: A continuing downtrend is a sequence of lows with lower highs between them; the uptrend mirror is highs with retracements.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Trend context is computed and recorded but never gates a trade.

educator.statement: A body close beyond a structure level counts as a structural shift, with no stated minimum size.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO enforces an ordered break/retest sequence; the educator states no minimum displacement, MOGO adds rejectionDisplacementATRMultiplier=0.25 (ALEX_X_006).

evidence.introducedBy: v12.10.0 (Unit A structureRefs) + v12.11.0 (Unit B attribution)

educator.statement: Break-and-retest is a CONTINUATION pattern: price breaks a structure point, returns to retest it, then continues in the original direction.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Break-then-retest continuation is implemented as a first-class setup type (B_breakRetest).

evidence.introducedBy: v12.10.0 (Unit A structureRefs) + v12.11.0 (Unit B attribution)

educator.statement: A level qualifies as a break-and-retest level only if it carries a MINIMUM OF ONE structure point.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Educator: MINIMUM ONE structure point. MOGO: requires touchIndex>=3 AND zone.touches.length>=4 for the repeated-reaction setup. MOGO is materially STRICTER than the educator states.

educator.statement: Once a zone is broken and retested it becomes the next structure point, so the pattern chains recursively.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Recursive chaining of retested zones into new structure points is not modelled as such.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: Break-and-retest is MOST EFFECTIVE at a pre-existing zone.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO only ever evaluates setups at detected zones, which satisfies the comparative preference.

educator.statement: Zone width is unconstrained -- 'doesn't matter the size of the box' -- subject only to leaving enough room to contain multiple touches.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Educator: zone width is EXPLICITLY UNCONSTRAINED. MOGO: zoneClusterATRMultiplier=0.5 constrains clustering. MOGO imposes a constraint the educator explicitly declines to impose.

linkBasis: code location 'alexGAssignCluster (index.html:2763)' has no declared evidence-field mapping -- not guessed

educator.statement: Structure and continuation are read on the higher timeframe; the entry signal must be taken on a lower timeframe.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO evaluates zones and setups on H1/H4/D/W and does not drop to a lower timeframe for entry. There is no separate HTF-structure / LTF-entry split.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: A bullish engulfing candlestick confirmation is REQUIRED before a long break-and-retest trade is taken.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO has NO candlestick-confirmation requirement. Entry is the qualification candle's close. The educator's single hardest entry precondition is absent from the implementation.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: The confirmation demonstrated is a Morning Star: three doji rejection candles followed by one bullish engulfing candle.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: No Morning Star detection exists.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: The retest is complete when rejection candlesticks appear -- it is not timed or measured.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Educator: retest ends when rejection candles appear. MOGO: reaction counts if confirmed within rejectionConfirmWithinBars=1 and displaces >=0.25 ATR (ALEX_X_006).

linkBasis: code location 'alexGAcceptReaction (index.html:2792)' has no declared evidence-field mapping -- not guessed

educator.statement: Entry is taken at the confirmation candle of the retest.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO enters at the qualification candle close; the educator indicates the confirmation candle without naming a price.

evidence.reason: cited implementation is on the LIVE paper-execution path; RUN-001 is a replay and never executed it

educator.statement: A structurally ideal break-and-retest is NOT taken when the engulfing confirmation does not appear.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO has no confirmation gate, so it cannot decline a setup for a missing confirmation. This is the fidelity gap with the clearest trade-eligibility consequence.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: On every break-and-retest trade the stop-loss is placed immediately BEYOND the rejection formation at the retest ('right under it' for a long).

implementation.implementationBehaviour: RELATIONSHIP MATCHES: stop sits just beyond the structure. ANCHOR DIFFERS: MOGO anchors on setup.zoneLow/zoneHigh (zone boundary); the educator anchors on the rejection formation at the retest. A rejection wick can extend well beyond the zone boundary, so these are not the same object.

evidence.reason: cited implementation is on the LIVE paper-execution path; RUN-001 is a replay and never executed it

educator.statement: [NO RULE EXISTS] The distance between the stop and the rejection structure.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: stopATRBuffer = 0.25 ATR. NO educator counterpart exists -- no ALEX_G claim in 9 sources mentions ATR at all. Entirely MOGO-authored.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus is in the MOGO-authored/unsupported set

educator.statement: [NO RULE EXISTS] The short-side stop placement.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO implements the short-side stop symmetrically (zoneHigh + buffer). The educator never states the short-side rule, so MOGO's symmetry is an assumption, not a match.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus is in the MOGO-authored/unsupported set

educator.statement: The take-profit is set to a MINIMUM of 1:2 risk-to-reward.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Educator: 1:2 is a MINIMUM (floor). MOGO: minRR=2.0 is a FIXED ratio -- target = entry +/- 2.0 x risk, always. These are different rules that coincide at the boundary. MOGO can never take the 1:3 or 1:4 the educator also describes.

linkBasis: implementation is configuration parameter 'minRR'; snapshotAlexGConfig() copies RULES_ALEXG.config verbatim onto every package

educator.statement: [NO RULE EXISTS] How the target level is chosen when structure allows more than 1:2.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: No educator target-selection procedure exists, so MOGO's fixed 2R cannot be compared against one.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus 'UNRESOLVED' does not assert an implementation

educator.statement: Risk is sized as a percentage of the account balance, never as a fixed monetary amount, and the same percentage is risked on every trade.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: riskAmount = balanceBefore * (riskPercent/100) -- percentage-based off account balance, fixed per trade. This is the closest genuine agreement between MOGO and the educator on any risk rule.

linkBasis: code location 'index.html:3512' has no declared evidence-field mapping -- not guessed

educator.statement: Three risk bands: conservative 0.5-1%, recommended/industry-standard 1-2%, high 3-5%.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO uses riskPercent=1.0, which falls inside BOTH the conservative (0.5-1%) and recommended (1-2%) bands. Consistent with the educator, but MOGO chose the single value; the educator states bands and an account-type dependency MOGO does not model.

linkBasis: implementation is configuration parameter 'riskPercent'; snapshotAlexGConfig() copies RULES_ALEXG.config verbatim onto every package

educator.statement: The high band (3-5%) is confined to a personal or disposable account, and to the months November-March.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: No account-type or calendar-month risk modulation.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: Once chosen, the risk percentage is not raised after wins or lowered after losses; his own practice fixes one percentage per calendar month.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: riskPercent is a constant, so it is never raised after wins or lowered after losses. MOGO satisfies the stability rule by construction.

linkBasis: implementation is configuration parameter 'riskPercent'; snapshotAlexGConfig() copies RULES_ALEXG.config verbatim onto every package

educator.statement: A losing trade is allowed to reach its stop without intervention; the loss is accepted as normal variance.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO never intervenes between entry and exit: the stop and target are frozen at entry and never trailed or moved. Matches the demonstrated no-intervention behaviour.

evidence.reason: cited implementation is on the LIVE paper-execution path; RUN-001 is a replay and never executed it

educator.statement: No action is taken while price travels toward the area of interest; the setup is left alone until price arrives.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: No action is taken until a setup qualifies at the zone.

educator.statement: A target set in advance should be allowed to run rather than cut when the unrealised figure becomes emotionally significant.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: The target is frozen at entry and never cut early.

evidence.reason: cited implementation is on the LIVE paper-execution path; RUN-001 is a replay and never executed it

educator.statement: After missing an entry, set an alarm for the next pullback rather than chase.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Human behaviour; no automation counterpart.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: [NO RULE EXISTS] Whether the stop is ever moved to break-even.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO documents 'never trailed or moved to break-even' as an explicit MOGO choice. The educator says nothing either way, so this is a MOGO decision in an evidentiary vacuum -- not a match.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus is in the MOGO-authored/unsupported set

educator.statement: [NO RULE EXISTS] Whether any portion of a position is closed before the full target.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO takes no partials. Educator silent.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus is in the MOGO-authored/unsupported set

educator.statement: [NO RULE EXISTS] Whether a position is ever added to or reduced after entry.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO is single-entry. Educator silent.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus is in the MOGO-authored/unsupported set

educator.statement: [NO RULE EXISTS] Whether the stop is ever trailed.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO does not trail. Educator silent.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus is in the MOGO-authored/unsupported set

educator.statement: A break-and-retest on a higher timeframe is more respected than one on a lower timeframe.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: htfPriority {W:4,D:3,H4:2,H1:1} orders competing setups. It never gates, weights or sizes a trade, so 'more respected' is only partially realised.

linkBasis: code location 'alexGSetupSortComparator (index.html:3589)' has no declared evidence-field mapping -- not guessed

educator.statement: Top-down analysis uses four tiers: weekly, daily, 4-hour, and the lower timeframes (2H/1H/30m/15m; below 15m is not a strong timeframe).

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO processes H1/H4/D/W. Educator names W/D/4H plus 2H/1H/30m/15m. MOGO omits the sub-H1 tiers entirely and adds none.

educator.statement: Day trading reads break-and-retest on 4H/1H; swing trading on daily/weekly.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: No day-trade vs swing-trade mode distinction exists.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: Entry timing is governed by session and day-of-week; a valid confirmation at the wrong time is not traded. Entries are restricted to Monday-Wednesday.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Session and day metadata ARE computed and recorded but NEVER restrict entry. The educator states an explicit Mon-Wed restriction and a session gate; MOGO applies neither. Recorded in the manifest as 'a deliberate design choice, not a source gap' -- that note predates the session evidence.

linkBasis: fidelityStatus states MOGO does not implement this rule

educator.statement: [PARAMETER ABSENT] The exact hours of the tradeable session windows.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Parameter absent from source; nothing to compare.

educator.statement: The pattern applies to all timeframes and all instrument classes -- currencies, commodities, futures, stocks.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: Educator states universal applicability. MOGO trades a fixed instrument set via its own scan configuration.

implementation.implementationBehaviour: MOGO adds a choppy-zone filter (>=3 penetrations / 50 bars). The educator states no such filter.
